name: mimir
description: Mimir for OpenAI Codex CLI — persona, lifecycle-hook brain, local memory, and cartographer indexing. This plugin is the bootstrap: its skill installs the mimir-codex binary, which lands the real runtime in a dedicated CODEX_HOME.

interface.longDescription: Bootstrap plugin for Mimir in Codex. Codex plugins can bundle lifecycle hooks, but Mimir deliberately installs into a dedicated CODEX_HOME (~/.mimir/codex) instead: your own ~/.codex stays untouched, and the installer can trust its hooks automatically through codex app-server. Ask codex to 'install mimir' — the skill downloads the released mimir-codex binary and runs its installer, which lands the persona, hooks, trust ledger, and MCP wiring there.
